title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Sept. 28, 2026
total: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Sept. 28, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.

properties.name: In Japan
properties.said: USS Tripoli (LHA-7) is in port in Sasebo, Japan.

properties.name: In the Pacific Ocean
properties.said: The Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group departed last Sunday from Apra Harbor, Guam, and is transiting the Pacific Ocean en route to California. On Sunday, Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao visited Lincoln while the carrier was sailing near Hawaii.

properties.name: In the Caribbean
properties.said:
Littoral combat ship USS Billings (LCS-15) is operating in the Central Caribbean Sea. The Freedom-class LCS is based at Naval Station Mayport, Fla. The 24th MEU is operating in the region as Littoral Combat Force 24 and is spread throughout the region, including aboard USS San Antonio (LPD-17).

San Antonio is in port in Ponce, Puerto Rico, having transited the Panama Canal northbound on Thursday. USS Gridley (DDG-101) transited with San Antonio and is in port in Panama.

properties.name: In the Eastern Pacific
properties.said:
Aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) departed on deployment Sunday from San Diego, Calif.

Carrier Strike Group 9 is composed of Theodore Roosevelt , Carrier Air Wing (CVW) 11, Destroyer Squadron 23, Information Warfare Squadron 9, and the Ticonderoga-class guided-missile cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65).
